document.title: One-line file notes on what changed in each file of a group
document.summary: Groups gain optional `fileNotes`, one line per file keyed by its head path. `validate` rejects a note on a path the group does not cover, `refresh` drops a note when its file changes, the file header shows it, and the skill says when to write one.
document.why: [PR #173](source:pr) says a reader of a multi-file group still has to guess what changed in each file, and asks for one quiet line per file.

sources.title: One-line file notes on what changed in each file of a group
sources.gist: Adds a one-line note per file of a group, kept to one muted line in the file header.

groups.title: Schema and validate
groups.why: The skill writes `fileNotes`, so the schema must accept them and `validate` must catch a note on the wrong file.
groups.summary: `fileNotes` in `review.ts` is a map from path to line, and `fileNoteErrors` in `anchors.ts` checks each key against the live hunks of its group.

notes.body: Lockfiles have no live hunks, so a note on a lockfile path fails here. The UI shows lockfiles in their own bucket, where the note would not appear.

fileNotes.src/schema/review.ts: Adds `fileNotes` as a record of non-empty strings on a group.
fileNotes.src/review/anchors.ts: New `fileNoteErrors`: one error listing every note off its group.
fileNotes.src/schema/source.ts: A file note may cite a source like other prose.
fileNotes.src/schema/parse.test.ts: Rejects an empty note and the array shape.
fileNotes.src/test/covering-document.ts: The fixture's Moved block group gets two file notes.
fileNotes.src/review/anchors.test.ts: Validate cases: another group's file, a lockfile, a missing path.

groups.title: Refresh drops a note when its file changes
groups.why: A file note describes the whole file's change, so it is stale once that file's hunks change.
groups.summary: `refreshDocument` keeps a file note only when no hunk of its file is changed, reformatted, new, or gone, and `formatRefresh` counts the ones it drops.

attention.note: Any new, edited, or whitespace-only hunk in the file drops the note, even a hunk another group owns. A note that still holds is lost and must be written again. Decide whether that cost beats keeping a stale note.

notes.body: `delta.added` is every new hunk in the diff, not only this group's, so a split file loses its note in each group.

fileNotes.src/review/refresh.ts: Builds `editedPaths` and filters each group's file notes against it.
fileNotes.src/review/anchors.test.ts: Keep on a same file, drop on a changed or new hunk.

groups.title: File header line
groups.why: [PR #173](source:pr) asks for one muted line in the header the UI already shows, with no new block.
groups.summary: `Group` passes the note for each file to `HunkView`, which shows it in the header row the rename badge uses.

fileNotes.src/ui/components/HunkView.tsx: Renders the note as muted `InlineMd`; renames the line-note local to `lineNotes`.

groups.title: Skill rule and glossary
groups.why: The skill decides how often notes appear, which sets how noisy a review gets.
groups.summary: The new File notes section in `SKILL.md` asks for a note on each file of a multi-file group unless the group `summary` covers it, and the glossary defines File note.

attention.note: The rule asks for a note on every file of a group with two or more files. In the `comprehende-57` smoke run that was 11 notes over 3 groups. Decide whether that density fits the noise budget, or whether notes should be only for files the summary leaves unclear.

fileNotes.skills-next/comprehende/SKILL.md: New File notes section; validate, refresh, and prose lists name it.
fileNotes.skills-next/comprehende/references/examp: The two-file `cookie` group gets a note per file.
fileNotes.docs/glossary.md: Adds File note; Refresh, Citation, and Review document mention it.

groups.title: Eval rubric and grader
groups.why: The eval must see file notes to judge the new skill rule.
groups.summary: The grader packet prints each file note under its file, the grader checks file notes as claims, and `comprehende-57` gains rubric lines for the rule.

fileNotes.eval/cases/comprehende-57/expected.md: Good: short notes on schema copies. Must not: summary repeats.
fileNotes.scripts/eval/packet.ts: Prints `File note:` under the file heading.
fileNotes.scripts/eval/graders.ts: `claimBullets` and the prompt include file notes.
fileNotes.scripts/eval/graders.test.ts: Expects the file note bullet last in its group.
fileNotes.scripts/eval/checks.ts: Prose lints read file notes too.
fileNotes.docs/eval.md: The grader marks file notes true or false at head.

groups.why: `pnpm generate:schema` and `pnpm sync:skill` write these from the sources above.
groups.summary: The JSON Schema and the skill copies are generated output; skip them once `pnpm check:skill` passes.

commits.subject: File notes: reject lockfile paths, grade file notes as claims
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Lockfiles render in their own bucket and carry no hunks, so a note on one never showed and refresh dropped it. validate now names it like any other path outside the group.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: File notes: one line per file on what changed in it
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Groups gain fileNotes, keyed by the head path of a file the group covers. validate names a note on any other path. refresh keeps a file note while every hunk of its file is the same and drops it otherwise. The UI shows the line under the file name in the file header.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
